a.xlink:title: Project completion requires supported and readable selected thesis claims, truthful code/data/reproduction and availability promises, a frozen candidate meeting the recorded human PASS threshold, required delivery/archive dispositions, and released assignments. This map does not assert any present whole-project readiness. blocker: Workflow implementation/acceptance, thesis source/support/human PASS, code/evidence and reproduction checks, actual delivery/archive dispositions and final session release remain unfinished. plan_gap: The 4 October bounded run is selected. Human acceptance, university submission status and optional workflow activation remain unknown or outside this run. project: msc-math authorization: Current authorization is preservation and handoff; original thesis run was stopped by Jörn. next_step: Thesis execution stopped. Preserve the checkpoint and use the restart handoff only when Jörn instructs continuation. Sources: docs/coordination/thesis-work.md, docs/coordination/handoff.md, docs/project-facts.md, ARCHITECTURE.md

Selected project-local skills and workflow deliverables integrated and working against the agreed support contract, with evidence and caveats retained; all assignments closed and their sessions released. Plans alone do not establish readiness. Thesis execution remains STOPPED. blocker: Selected completion package and acceptance criteria are not agreed; delivery, acceptance and session release remain unfinished. project: workflows authorization: Only the recorded selected assignment is authorized; future activation/execution remains separately selected. next_step: Select the reviewed local migration and acceptance package; workflow readiness is one subproject, not whole-project completion. Sources: docs/development-environments.md, docs/coordination/handoff.md

Select whether retained-file/manual receipt suffices or a bounded live send/ack test is required. project: workflows authorization: Only the recorded selected assignment is authorized; future activation/execution remains separately selected.
